additive_runtime_changes: SQLite skip_attempt closes the current Attempt under lease/fencing, registers checkpoint Artifacts, releases the Lease, marks the Step skipped, and records step_skipped.
claim_next_step accepts an optional workflow_version filter; fixed and bounded workers bind their own workflow version.
durable-paper adds an explicit bounded strategy while fixed remains the parser and runtime default.
Bounded delivery manifest retains Context, Plan, validation, both search-slot dispositions, synthesis, usage, report, Evidence and Citation lineage.

necessary_boundary_extension.change: bind the existing fixed Runtime worker to DURABLE_WORKFLOW_VERSION
necessary_boundary_extension.reason: prevent a fixed worker and bounded worker sharing one SQLite queue from claiming each other's Steps

plan_contract_rejected with preserved violations and zero arXiv calls

zero Planner and arXiv calls after transactional reservation denial

known_boundaries: Fixture Provider responses prove orchestration semantics, not that a real model can produce valid or useful Plans.
Fixture Atom responses prove the two-slot durable path, not live arXiv behavior or research-quality improvement.
W4.3 does not compare A/B/C candidate quality and does not admit bounded as a user-selectable production strategy beyond the explicit experimental CLI flag.
Cancellation, subprocess kill and broader injection combinations for the bounded nine-Step graph remain W4.4 work; W3 mechanisms only passed their existing regression tests.
No non-terminal Workbench entry exists; this remains a W5 product gap.
evidence_boundary: W4.3 proves offline durable orchestration of a static bounded two-slot strategy with fixture transports. It does not prove live Planner capability, live arXiv execution, quality gain over deterministic strategy B, personal-use acceptance, or general Agent capability.
authorization_consumed: W4.3 offline Runtime and CLI integration only
next_acceptance_point: W4.4 safety, budget, recovery and fault matrix; no W4.4 implementation begins until the user explicitly enters W4.4
